metadata.name: Japan PM2.5 Domain Knowledge Base
metadata.description: Structured knowledge base for natural language to Cypher query generation over the Japan PM2.5 monitoring knowledge graph. Covers schema, health standards, temporal rules, traversal policies, and validated query patterns.
metadata.note_on_schema_names: This DKB documents a CONCEPTUAL schema (Station, Location, Timestamp, Observation, PM2.5Value) that maps cleanly to domain language. The ACTUAL KG uses (Station, Location, ObservationTime, ObservedPM25). All Cypher patterns use ACTUAL KG property names. See schema_bridge for the mapping.

ObservationTime.description: Hourly timestamp with rich temporal attributes

ObservedPM25.description: PM2.5 measurement paired 1-to-1 with an ObservationTime

schema_bridge.description: Maps conceptual domain vocabulary to actual KG property names

node_mapping.Observation (conceptual): implicit join of ObservedPM25 + ObservationTime via shared tid

node_types.name: Station
node_types.description: An air quality monitoring station in Japan, operated under the national Soramame-kun network

sid.description: Unique station identifier (8-digit Japanese monitoring code)

node_types.name: Location
node_types.description: Geographic position of a monitoring station — prefecture, city, and coordinates

node_types.name: ObservationTime
node_types.description: A specific hourly timestamp enriched with temporal context attributes

tid.description: Unique time node ID matching ObservedPM25.tid

season.note: Some records null; use t.season IS NOT NULL when filtering

timeCategory.note: Some records null; use t.timeCategory IS NOT NULL when filtering

example_nodes: ObservationTime(tid='T536', year=2018, month=9, hour=1, dayType='Weekend', season='Autumn', timeCategory='Night')

node_types.name: ObservedPM25
node_types.description: A PM2.5 concentration reading — paired 1-to-1 with an ObservationTime node via shared tid

pm25.note: Valid range 0–500. Raw data contains sensor errors outside this range; always filter WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500 for numeric analysis

pm25_level.note: Pre-computed Japan-standard classification; use for fast indexed lookups

relationship_types.name: LOCATED_AT
relationship_types.description: Each station has exactly one geographic location

relationship_types.name: AT_LOCATION
relationship_types.description: Each observation timestamp is associated with one location (via the station that recorded it)

relationship_types.name: OBSERVED_AT
relationship_types.description: Each PM2.5 reading is paired with exactly one timestamp

relationship_types.name: RECORDED_BY
relationship_types.description: Each PM2.5 reading was recorded by one station

pm25_health_rules.name: Japan Environmental Quality Standard
pm25_health_rules.description: Japan's national PM2.5 standard: daily average ≤ 35 µg/m³ (also annual average ≤ 15 µg/m³). Stations meeting this are Safe or Moderate level.

pm25_health_rules.name: Safe
pm25_health_rules.description: PM2.5 ≤ 15 µg/m³. Within Japan's annual guideline. No health risk.

pm25_health_rules.name: Moderate
pm25_health_rules.description: PM2.5 15–35 µg/m³. Approaching Japan daily limit. Sensitive groups should reduce outdoor activity.

pm25_health_rules.name: Slightly Unhealthy
pm25_health_rules.description: PM2.5 35–70 µg/m³. Exceeds Japan daily standard. Sensitive groups (elderly, children, respiratory patients) should avoid prolonged outdoor activity.

pm25_health_rules.name: Unhealthy
pm25_health_rules.description: PM2.5 70–115 µg/m³. General population health effects. All groups should reduce outdoor activity.

pm25_health_rules.name: Very Unhealthy
pm25_health_rules.description: PM2.5 > 115 µg/m³. Severely elevated. All outdoor activity should be avoided.

pm25_health_rules.name: WHO Annual Mean Guideline
pm25_health_rules.description: WHO tightened 2021 annual guideline: 5 µg/m³ annual mean. Most Japan stations exceed this.

pm25_health_rules.name: WHO 24-Hour Mean Guideline
pm25_health_rules.description: WHO 2021 daily guideline: 15 µg/m³. This aligns with Japan's 'Safe' level ceiling.

pm25_health_rules.name: Valid Sensor Reading Range
pm25_health_rules.description: IMPORTANT: Raw Japan KG data contains sensor-error values (range: -10000 to 65535). Always apply this filter for any numeric aggregation (avg, max, percentile). The pre-computed pm25_level field is already cleaned — use pm25_level for categorical queries without needing this filter.

temporal_rules.name: Spring
temporal_rules.japan_context: Peak season for kosa (黄砂, Asian dust/yellow sand) events transported from the Gobi and Taklamakan deserts. PM2.5 can spike significantly in western Japan (Kyushu, Chugoku). Cherry blossom season correlates with elevated dust events.

temporal_rules.name: Summer
temporal_rules.japan_context: Generally lowest PM2.5 season. Rainy season (tsuyu/梅雨) in June-July washes out particulates. Pacific high pressure brings clean air. Typhoon season (August-September) can occasionally bring elevated readings from the continent.

temporal_rules.name: Autumn
temporal_rules.japan_context: Moderate PM2.5 levels. Transition from Pacific air mass to continental influence. November sees increasing PM2.5 as winter approaches and Siberian high builds.

temporal_rules.name: Winter
temporal_rules.japan_context: Highest PM2.5 season. Siberian High drives continental air masses loaded with particulates from China and Korea across the Sea of Japan. Western-facing prefectures (Fukuoka, Osaka, Ishikawa) most affected. Heating fuel combustion adds local sources.

temporal_rules.name: Peak Pollution Period
temporal_rules.japan_context: Combined winter + early spring: highest PM2.5 period driven by both Asian continental transport and kosa dust events. Critical period for health advisories.

temporal_rules.name: Morning Rush Hour
temporal_rules.definition: Weekday 7–9 AM — peak traffic, relevant for Roadside stations

japan_geographic_context.note: Western Japan prefectures facing the Sea of Japan (Fukuoka, Yamaguchi, Ishikawa) receive highest transboundary pollution. Tokyo and Osaka also elevated due to urban density.

station_types.General Station: Background monitoring — measures ambient air quality away from direct traffic
station_types.Roadside Station: Traffic-adjacent monitoring — measures direct vehicle emission impact

traversal_policies.description: Use pm25_level (indexed string) instead of numeric pm25 comparisons wherever possible. The index lookup is orders of magnitude faster over 71M nodes.
traversal_policies.exception: Use numeric filter only when threshold doesn't align with a level boundary (e.g. WHO 15 µg/m³)

traversal_policies.description: Start traversal from Station (1,116) or Location (1,116) — not from ObservedPM25 (71M). Always push geographic filters to the start of the MATCH clause.
year and month are indexed on ObservationTime. Filter on these before hour or timeCategory.
For any numeric aggregation (avg, max, percentile) always apply the sensor validity filter. Omit only when using pm25_level categorical filters.
traversal_policies.applies_to: All queries using avg(p.pm25), max(p.pm25), min(p.pm25), percentile functions

traversal_policies.description: Neo4j 2026 requires ORDER BY and LIMIT to appear in a WITH clause, not after RETURN when LIMIT may be appended. Always structure as: WITH ... ORDER BY ... LIMIT N RETURN ...
traversal_policies.good_pattern:
WITH station, avg_pm25 ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC LIMIT 10
RETURN station, avg_pm25
traversal_policies.avoid_pattern: RETURN station, avg(pm25) AS avg_pm25 ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC LIMIT 10

traversal_policies.description: To find which station recorded a measurement, use RECORDED_BY directly from ObservedPM25. Do not traverse via ObservationTime → Location → Station.
When comparing traffic impact, filter stationtype_en. 'Roadside Station' captures vehicle emissions directly; 'General Station' captures background ambient levels.

query_patterns.nl_template: Which stations have the most [level] PM2.5 readings?
query_patterns.nl_example: Which Japanese stations have the most unhealthy PM2.5 readings?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station)
WHERE p.pm25_level IN ['Unhealthy', 'Very Unhealthy', 'Slightly Unhealthy']
WITH s.stationname_en AS station, s.stationtype_en AS type, count(p) AS unhealthy_count
ORDER BY unhealthy_count DESC
LIMIT 10
RETURN station, type, unhealthy_count

query_patterns.nl_template: What is the average PM2.5 in [prefecture]?
query_patterns.nl_example: What is the average PM2.5 in Aichi Prefecture?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE l.prefecture_en = $prefecture
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS total_readings

query_patterns.nl_template: Which prefectures have the highest average PM2.5?
query_patterns.nl_example: Rank Japan's prefectures by average PM2.5 pollution
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture, round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 15
RETURN prefecture, avg_pm25

query_patterns.nl_template: What is the average PM2.5 in each season across Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: How does PM2.5 vary by season in Japan?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
  AND t.season IS NOT NULL
RETURN t.season AS season,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: Which prefecture has the worst PM2.5 during [season]?
query_patterns.nl_example: Which Japanese prefecture has the highest PM2.5 in winter?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE t.season = $season
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture, round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 10
RETURN prefecture, avg_pm25

query_patterns.nl_template: How does PM2.5 differ between roadside and general monitoring stations?
query_patterns.nl_example: Compare average PM2.5 at roadside stations vs general stations in Japan
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN s.stationtype_en AS station_type,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       round(percentileCont(p.pm25, 0.95), 2) AS p95_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: List all monitoring stations in [prefecture]
query_patterns.nl_example: Show all PM2.5 monitoring stations in Fukuoka Prefecture
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (s:Station)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE l.prefecture_en = $prefecture
RETURN s.stationname_en AS station,
       s.stationtype_en AS type,
       l.city_en AS city,
       l.lat AS lat,
       l.lon AS lon
ORDER BY s.stationname_en

query_patterns.nl_template: How has annual average PM2.5 changed over the years in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show the year-over-year PM2.5 trend in Japan from 2018 to 2026
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.year AS year,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY year

query_patterns.nl_template: What is the hourly PM2.5 pattern throughout the day in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show how PM2.5 varies hour by hour across Japan
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.hour AS hour,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY hour

query_patterns.nl_template: Is PM2.5 higher on weekdays or weekends in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Compare average PM2.5 on weekdays versus weekends
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.dayType AS day_type,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: How does PM2.5 compare during rush hour vs off-peak at roadside stations?
query_patterns.nl_example: Compare PM2.5 at roadside stations during morning rush hour vs rest of the day on weekdays
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station),
      (p)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE s.stationtype_en = 'Roadside Station'
  AND t.dayType = 'Weekday'
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH t.hour AS hour, round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
     CASE WHEN t.hour IN [7,8,9] THEN 'Morning Rush'
          WHEN t.hour IN [17,18,19] THEN 'Evening Rush'
          ELSE 'Off-Peak' END AS period
WITH period, round(avg(avg_pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
RETURN period, avg_pm25

query_patterns.nl_template: Which prefectures exceed the WHO 24-hour guideline most frequently in winter?
query_patterns.nl_example: How often does each prefecture exceed the WHO 15 µg/m³ guideline during winter?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE t.season = 'Winter'
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
     count(p) AS total,
     count(CASE WHEN p.pm25 > 15.0 THEN 1 END) AS exceeds_who
WITH prefecture, total, exceeds_who,
     round(100.0 * exceeds_who / total, 1) AS exceed_pct
ORDER BY exceed_pct DESC
LIMIT 15
RETURN prefecture, exceeds_who, total, exceed_pct

query_patterns.nl_template: Give a complete PM2.5 profile for station [name]
query_patterns.nl_example: Show the complete PM2.5 profile for station shussui in Kagoshima
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE s.stationname_en = $station_name
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN s.stationname_en AS station,
       s.stationtype_en AS type,
       l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
       l.city_en AS city,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       round(min(p.pm25), 2) AS min_pm25,
       round(max(p.pm25), 2) AS max_pm25,
       count(p) AS total_readings,
       count(CASE WHEN p.pm25_level = 'Safe' THEN 1 END) AS safe_count,
       count(CASE WHEN p.pm25_level IN ['Unhealthy','Very Unhealthy'] THEN 1 END) AS unhealthy_count

query_patterns.nl_template: Show the monthly PM2.5 pattern in Japan
query_patterns.nl_example: What is the average PM2.5 for each month of the year in Japan?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.month AS month,
       t.month_name AS month_name,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY month

query_patterns.nl_template: Show annual PM2.5 trend for station [name]
query_patterns.nl_example: How has PM2.5 changed year by year at station shussui?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station),
      (p)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE s.stationname_en = $station_name
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.year AS year,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY year

query_patterns.nl_template: Which prefectures have the cleanest air (highest % of Safe readings)?
query_patterns.nl_example: Rank prefectures by percentage of Safe PM2.5 readings
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
     count(p) AS total,
     count(CASE WHEN p.pm25_level = 'Safe' THEN 1 END) AS safe_count
WHERE total > 0
WITH prefecture, total, safe_count,
     round(100.0 * safe_count / total, 1) AS safe_pct
ORDER BY safe_pct DESC
LIMIT 15
RETURN prefecture, safe_pct, safe_count, total

query_patterns.nl_template: What percentage of readings fall in each PM2.5 category in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show the overall distribution of PM2.5 levels across Japan
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)
WHERE p.pm25_level IS NOT NULL
WITH p.pm25_level AS level, count(p) AS cnt
ORDER BY cnt DESC
RETURN level, cnt

query_patterns.nl_template: Which day of the week has the worst PM2.5 in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show average PM2.5 for each day of the week
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN t.weekday_name AS weekday,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: Find PM2.5 spikes (Unhealthy or worse) in [prefecture] in [year]
query_patterns.nl_example: Find all Unhealthy PM2.5 events in Fukuoka Prefecture in 2022
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location),
      (p)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE l.prefecture_en = $prefecture
  AND t.year = $year
  AND p.pm25_level IN ['Unhealthy', 'Very Unhealthy']
WITH s.stationname_en AS station,
     t.obsdate AS datetime,
     t.season AS season,
     p.pm25 AS pm25,
     p.pm25_level AS level
ORDER BY pm25 DESC
LIMIT 20
RETURN station, datetime, season, pm25, level

query_patterns.nl_template: Which prefectures are most affected by spring kosa (Asian dust) events?
query_patterns.nl_example: Rank prefectures by average PM2.5 in spring — indicators of Asian dust impact
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE t.season = 'Spring'
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture, round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC
LIMIT 15
RETURN prefecture, avg_pm25

query_patterns.nl_template: What fraction of all Japan hourly readings exceed the WHO 24-hour guideline?
query_patterns.nl_example: How often does Japan's PM2.5 exceed the WHO 15 µg/m³ guideline?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH count(p) AS total,
     count(CASE WHEN p.pm25 > 15.0 THEN 1 END) AS exceeds
RETURN total, exceeds, round(100.0 * exceeds / total, 2) AS exceed_pct

query_patterns.nl_template: Compare seasonal PM2.5 variation at station [name]
query_patterns.nl_example: How does PM2.5 vary by season at the shussui station?
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station),
      (p)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE s.stationname_en = $station_name
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
  AND t.season IS NOT NULL
RETURN t.season AS season,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       round(max(p.pm25), 2) AS max_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: How many hours per year does PM2.5 exceed Japan's daily standard across the country?
query_patterns.nl_example: Count hours per year where PM2.5 exceeded Japan's 35 µg/m³ standard
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25_level IN ['Slightly Unhealthy', 'Unhealthy', 'Very Unhealthy']
RETURN t.year AS year,
       count(p) AS hours_exceeded
ORDER BY year

query_patterns.nl_template: How does PM2.5 vary by time of day in Japan?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show average PM2.5 for each time category (morning, afternoon, evening, night)
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
  AND t.timeCategory IS NOT NULL
RETURN t.timeCategory AS time_of_day,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       count(p) AS readings
ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC

query_patterns.nl_template: What month has the highest PM2.5 in each prefecture?
query_patterns.nl_example: Find the month with worst air quality for each Japanese prefecture
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH l.prefecture_en AS prefecture, t.month_name AS month,
     round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25
WITH prefecture, collect({month: month, avg_pm25: avg_pm25}) AS monthly
WITH prefecture,
     reduce(best = {month: null, avg_pm25: 0.0}, m IN monthly |
       CASE WHEN m.avg_pm25 > best.avg_pm25 THEN m ELSE best END) AS peak
RETURN prefecture, peak.month AS peak_month, peak.avg_pm25 AS peak_pm25
LIMIT 47

query_patterns.nl_template: Show full PM2.5 statistics for [prefecture]
query_patterns.nl_example: Give complete PM2.5 statistics including percentiles for Osaka Prefecture
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(t:ObservationTime)-[:AT_LOCATION]->(l:Location)
WHERE l.prefecture_en = $prefecture
  AND p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
RETURN l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
       round(avg(p.pm25), 2) AS avg_pm25,
       round(min(p.pm25), 2) AS min_pm25,
       round(max(p.pm25), 2) AS max_pm25,
       round(percentileCont(p.pm25, 0.5), 2) AS median_pm25,
       round(percentileCont(p.pm25, 0.95), 2) AS p95_pm25,
       count(p) AS total_readings

query_patterns.nl_template: Which stations meet the WHO annual PM2.5 guideline?
query_patterns.nl_example: Find Japanese stations whose average PM2.5 is below the WHO annual 5 µg/m³ guideline
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (p:ObservedPM25)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(s:Station)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500
WITH s.stationname_en AS station,
     l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
     s.stationtype_en AS type,
     avg(p.pm25) AS avg_pm25
WHERE avg_pm25 <= 5.0
RETURN station, prefecture, type, round(avg_pm25, 2) AS avg_pm25
ORDER BY avg_pm25

query_patterns.nl_template: How many monitoring stations are in each prefecture?
query_patterns.nl_example: Show the number of PM2.5 monitoring stations per Japanese prefecture
query_patterns.cypher:
MATCH (s:Station)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
RETURN l.prefecture_en AS prefecture,
       count(s) AS station_count,
       count(CASE WHEN s.stationtype_en = 'Roadside Station' THEN 1 END) AS roadside,
       count(CASE WHEN s.stationtype_en = 'General Station' THEN 1 END) AS general
ORDER BY station_count DESC

data_quality_notes.sensor_error_values: Raw pm25 values range from -10000 to 65535 µg/m³ — sensor malfunctions. Always filter WHERE p.pm25 >= 0 AND p.pm25 <= 500 for numeric queries.
data_quality_notes.null_fields: Some ObservationTime nodes have null season and timeCategory. Use IS NOT NULL guards when filtering on these.
data_quality_notes.null_pm25_level: Some ObservedPM25 nodes have null pm25_level. Use WHERE p.pm25_level IS NOT NULL for categorical queries.
data_quality_notes.pre_computed_levels: pm25_level is pre-computed and indexed — prefer it over raw numeric comparisons for performance.
